title: Share of 15–24-year-olds enrolled in vocational education (UIS)
description: Enrolment in vocational programmes (ISCED 2–5) of people aged 15–24 as a percentage of the population aged 15–24, both sexes.
comparability: For EU, EFTA and OECD countries these figures come from the same joint UNESCO-OECD-Eurostat (UOE) collection as Eurostat's education statistics; UIS adds candidate countries. 'Vocational' includes school-based as well as work-based (apprenticeship-type) programmes, so this measures the weight of VET, not of apprenticeship. The denominator is a population estimate (UN or Eurostat), so it reflects both VET popularity and how long young people stay in education.

provenance.citation: Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), indicator EV1524P.2T5.V, https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/, data version 20260507-91260335.
